from forte2 import AVAS, CISolver, MCOptimizer, RHF, State, System

xyz = """
C 0.0000000000 -0.0000000000 -0.5995429701
O 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 0.5993824041
H 0.0000000000 -0.9388178122 -1.1869891398
H 0.0000000000 0.9388178122 -1.1869891398
"""

system = System(
    xyz=xyz,
    basis_set="cc-pvdz",
    auxiliary_basis_set="def2-universal-jkfit",
    minao_basis_set="cc-pvtz-minao",
)

rhf = RHF(charge=0)(system)

avas = AVAS(
    subspace=["C(2px)","O(2px)"],
    selection_method="cumulative",
    sigma=0.98,
    diagonalize=True,
)(rhf)

ci_solver = CISolver(State(nel=rhf.nel, multiplicity=1, ms=0.0))
mc = MCOptimizer(ci_solver)(avas)
mc.run()
